questions.content: A pupil changes water temperature and stirring speed together. Why is the result difficult to interpret?
questions.answerKey: Either factor or their combination could affect dissolving time.
questions.markingGuide: Change one intended factor and control relevant alternatives.

questions.content: A beaker reading is 52 mL but its divisions are 10 mL apart. Explain why writing 52.000 mL is unjustified.
questions.answerKey: The notation implies precision unsupported by the instrument scale.
questions.markingGuide: More digits do not create a finer measurement.

questions.content: Give a report structure for a separation investigation.
questions.answerKey: Question, method, conditions, observations, results, conclusion and limitations.
questions.markingGuide: Keep observed facts separate from interpretation.

questions.content: Find the mean and range of 5.1, 5.3 and 5.2 s.
questions.answerKey: Mean5.2 s; range0.2 s.
questions.markingGuide: Add and divide by three; subtract minimum from maximum.

questions.content: A distance–time line passes (2 s,5 m) and (8 s,20 m). Find gradient.
Why is deleting an unusual reading without explanation poor practice?
questions.answerKey: It hides evidence and may conceal a real variation or method problem.
questions.markingGuide: Investigate and record any justified correction.

questions.content: Write a correct printed scientific name format using Homo sapiens.
questions.answerKey: Homo sapiens, italicised, genus capitalised and specific epithet lower case.
questions.markingGuide: Both words form the species name.

questions.content: Find total magnification for 15× eyepiece and 10× objective.
questions.markingGuide: Multiply the two values.

questions.content: Why should an organism not be classified from one convenient trait alone?
questions.answerKey: Unrelated organisms may share that trait; broader evidence is needed.
questions.markingGuide: Use flying as an example.

questions.content: Solve x+y=14 and x−y=4.
questions.markingGuide: Add, then substitute.

questions.content: Find the equation with gradient3 through (0,−2).
questions.markingGuide: The point gives the vertical intercept.

questions.content: Solve −3x+2<14.
questions.markingGuide: Subtract2 then divide by−3 and reverse the sign.

questions.content: Tunga mfano mmoja wa neno lenye maana zinazobadilika kwa muktadha.
questions.answerKey: Kichwa kinaweza kuwa sehemu ya mwili au kichwa cha habari.
questions.markingGuide: Sentensi zionyeshe maana zilizokusudiwa.

questions.content: Kwa nini si sahihi kusema Baraka ndiye aliyekopa kamusi?
questions.answerKey: Matini inasema Mwanaidi aliikopa.
questions.markingGuide: Jibu litegemee ushahidi.

questions.content: Andika ombi la kuuliza maana bila kumkatiza msemaji kwa ukali.
questions.answerKey: Samahani, ukimaliza naomba ufafanue neno hilo.
questions.markingGuide: Heshimu nafasi na kusudi la mazungumzo.

questions.content: Explain how a river can link physical and human geography.
questions.answerKey: Its flow and landforms affect settlements or farming, while human activity can change its quality.
questions.markingGuide: Show a two-way relationship.

questions.content: Why should a vegetation map be interpreted as broad categories?
questions.answerKey: Real vegetation varies with several factors and boundaries need not be uniform.
questions.markingGuide: Recognise simplification.

questions.content: Distinguish a lake from an ocean using regional examples.
questions.answerKey: Lake Tanganyika is inland; the Indian Ocean is a major salt-water ocean.
questions.markingGuide: Use correct feature types.

questions.content: A trader buys12 items at400 each and transport costs1200. Find relevant unit cost.
questions.answerKey: TSh500
questions.markingGuide: Total6000 divided by12.

questions.content: A trial produces15 items and sells9. What two quantities should the record distinguish?
questions.answerKey: Nine sales and six unsold items.
questions.markingGuide: Do not equate output with sales.

questions.content: Why should a trial plan include quality complaints as well as revenue?
questions.answerKey: Sales alone may conceal problems affecting future demand and responsibilities.
questions.markingGuide: Use more than one performance measure.

questions.content: Toa mfano wa matumizi ya urithi yanayohitaji ridhaa.
questions.answerKey: Kurekodi simulizi au maarifa ya mtoa taarifa.
questions.markingGuide: Heshimu masharti na faragha.

questions.content: Eleza tofauti ya kutengeneza ufundi mpya na kudai kitu ni cha kale.
questions.answerKey: Kazi mpya inaweza kutumia mbinu za jadi bila kuwa kitu kilichotengenezwa zamani.
questions.markingGuide: Maelezo yawe ya kweli.

questions.content: Kwa nini wenye urithi washirikishwe katika maonesho?
questions.answerKey: Maamuzi yanawaathiri na wana maarifa na uhusiano muhimu na urithi.
questions.markingGuide: Ushiriki uwe na heshima na uwajibikaji.

questions.content: Write an invitation that includes a place and time.
questions.answerKey: Dear Juma, please join us in the library on Tuesday at4 p.m. for a reading session. Let me know if you can attend.
questions.markingGuide: Include the activity and clear arrangements.

questions.content: Which is stronger evidence about school arrangements: a current named notice or an undated rumour? Explain.
questions.answerKey: The current named notice is more directly attributable and relevant.
questions.markingGuide: Source quality depends on evidence and context.

questions.content: Create two sentences using different meanings of light.
questions.answerKey: The bag is light. The lamp produces light.
questions.markingGuide: Make each meaning clear from context.
